handbookNote: Alaska Real Estate Broker license exam. Part of the 2026-09-03 R26 population-tier broker buildout (population order: UT > NV > IA > AR > KS > MS > ID > NE > WV > HI > NH > MT > RI > DE > SD > ND > AK > VT > WY). Exam vendor: Pearson VUE, under contract with the Alaska Real Estate Commission (Candidate Handbook #092200). National/General portion: 80 scored items + 5 unscored pretest, single combined 4-hour (240 min) time limit shared with the state portion (no separate per-portion timer, unlike most other states in this campaign). Alaska State Law portion: 60 scored items (vs. 40 for Salesperson -- Broker gets a 15-item Broker-only Section VII). Flat $115 exam fee. Passing score is a SCALED score of 75 (0-100 scale, NOT raw percent-correct). UNIQUE MECHANIC IN THIS CAMPAIGN: sections are separately graded, but failing EITHER section requires retaking the ENTIRE exam (both portions), not just the failed portion -- every other R26 state built so far (HI/NH/MT/RI/DE/ND) allows retaking only the failed section. track_registry models this as exam_question_count=140, exam_duration_sec=14400, pass_percent=75, min_correct=105 (round(140*0.75)). NATIONAL/GENERAL PORTION (80 items, 8 sections) reuses the exact same real Pearson VUE national item bank as Utah/Nevada/Kansas/Idaho/Nebraska/West Virginia/Montana/Rhode Island/Delaware -- Alaska's own Broker outline weights are IDENTICAL (10/8/10/15/12/9/8/8 across the same 8 sections). ALASKA STATE LAW PORTION (60 items, real Broker item counts): Powers of the Alaska Real Estate Commission (6, incl. the real Recovery Fund under AS 08.88.450-495 with BOTH a $15,000 per-transaction cap (.465) and a $50,000 per-licensee cap (.475), funded by licensee fees in lieu of a surety bond), Licensing (6, incl. mandatory E&O insurance under 12 AAC 02.510-.590 with real coverage minimums -- $100,000 per-claim, $300,000 aggregate, $2,500 max annual premium -- a distinct requirement from the Recovery Fund), Licensee Duties and Disclosures to the Public (9-11, Alaska's genuinely distinctive agency framework: NO default dual agency (AS 08.88.600), a 'neutral licensee' status requiring a separate standalone consent form titled 'Waiver of Right To Be Represented' rather than a clause in another document, and a post-2005 'designated licensee' system (AS 08.88.640) where different licensees at the same firm can represent opposing sides without imputing knowledge between them -- plus a real stigmatized-property disclosure rule requiring disclosure of a death within the property in the year before showing if known (AS 08.88.615)), Requirements Governing the Activities of Licensees (9, real advertising/supervision/document/trust-fund rules under AS 08.88 and 12 AAC 64), Personal Services Agreements (4-6, incl. Alaska's distinctive rule tying commission-earning to fulfilling a WRITTEN personal-services contract rather than the common-law procuring-cause standard, AS 08.88.361), Property Management (9, incl. the Alaska Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act AS 34.03 -- 2-month security deposit cap with no cap above $2,000/month rent, 24-hour entry notice, 14-day/30-day deposit-return windows), and Broker Only (15, largest state section -- trust account rules under 12 AAC 64.180-271 incl. a 5-business-day deposit rule with a real geographic/weather exception reflecting Alaska's remoteness, a $100 personal-funds maintenance cap, 15-day commission withdrawal window, 3-year record retention, and branch-office supervision limits under AS 08.88.311/12 AAC 64.120). Governing law: AS Title 8, Chapter 88 (Real Estate Brokers and Other Licensees) and 12 AAC 64 (Real Estate Commission administrative rules). This bank was drafted across 7 new state-topic drafting passes (the 8 national files were reused, not redrafted). Two separate drafting agents independently caught and corrected WebFetch's own AI-summarizer hallucinating wrong statute citations (invented AS 08.88.311/.381 references) by re-verifying against locally-extracted raw PDF text instead. Answers were deterministically rotated into final A/B/C/D position via scripts/tracks/rotate_broker_answers.js.
